turns.question: What was the total ad spend in EUR per non-cancelled order placed in September 2026?
turns.answer: The semantic layer has no ad-spend-per-order metric, so I cannot give that ratio; the closest metrics are Ad spend (EUR), which was 6,270.00 EUR for 1-30 September 2026, and Orders (cancelled included), which in the same period were 60 placed, 50 shipped and 10 cancelled. Freshness: Late: marketing.silver is ready only up to 2026-10-03T00:00Z, older than its 36 h deadline.
